name: portugal-mcp
summary: Portugal's public data for AI assistants in one MCP server: weather (IPMA), places, INE and Banco de Portugal statistics, Parliament, public contracts, dados.gov.pt, SNS health, medicines, fuel and EV charging, train/metro/bus timetables across Portugal, live buses, planned power cuts, tourism registers, Lisbon city data, wildfires.
author: Thiago Jacob Lannes
